schema.description: Recorded OIDC authorization-code completion of one flow. Nauthilus's part ends with the token response for the flow's code (state tokens_issued); a relying-party session after it is never observed. Only authorization-code flows carry this block; SAML, device-code, flows without grant evidence, and latched flows (decided by the latch) have none.

code_redeemable_until.description: Latest instant the issued code could be redeemed (event contract version lifetime); null without issuance or for an unknown version.

state.description: tokens_issued, redemption_rejected, and redemption_failed are observed and final. redemption_pending: the code may still be redeemed or its redemption still be exported. code_expired_redemption_not_observed: the code can no longer be redeemed and no redemption was observed; an event may have been dropped, so it never proves an abort. code_issuance_not_observed: recording was active, but neither issuance nor redemption was observed. not_recorded: the flow predates completion recording. unknown: evidence was unreadable, truncated, conflicting, or unclassified.

authentication.description: How the flow got its authenticated identity, as recorded with the code issuance; unknown without an observed issuance.

schema.title: SupportHistoryCompletion
